description.text:
A high-class pack released on 3 December 2021 that brought back cards that did well in battle, such as Single Strike and Rapid Strike Urshifu VMAX, Ice Rider and Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX, Rayquaza VMAX, Crobat V, Boss's Orders and Marnie, with new cards: Morpeko V-UNION, four cards that join into one, Mimikyu VMAX, whose attack grows stronger when its player has used the Supporter Acerola's Premonition that turn, Gloria, Dedenne and Druddigon. Each pack held eleven cards, one of them a holo basic Energy and one a Pokémon V, VMAX or V-UNION or a Super Rare, and many of the ordinary cards also came in mirror versions. The ordinary cards are numbered to 184. After them come 28 Character Rare and 42 Character Super Rare cards, full-art Super Rare Supporters, and eight black-and-gold Ultra Rare Pokémon VMAX, from Ice Rider Calyrex VMAX to Duraludon VMAX. In English a few of its cards came out in Brilliant Stars and the sets that followed in 2022, its full-art Supporters among them in those sets' Trainer Gallery subsets.

Its Character Rare (CHR) and Character Super Rare (CSR) cards show a Pokémon together with a Trainer: Pikachu VMAX with Red, Blaziken V with May, Zamazenta V with Hop, Zekrom with N and Flaaffy with Elesa, among others. The Character Rare had first appeared in Dream League in 2019; the Character Super Rare, for Pokémon V and VMAX, was new here.
